So the survey gets popover styling only; banner styling never applies.

1. Opt-in token is `instui-banner*` in the theme class. Works on **surveys and popovers**, **not alerts**.
2. Sizing: let the existing 30em container query decide. 450px < 480px → compact banner padding/typography.
3. Buttons/controls: apply the **full banner on-colour treatment** (inverse primary, ghost secondary/tertiary).
4. Overflow: keep `overflow: hidden` on the card.

Widen the banner root selector everywhere from:
```
:is(:scope, [class*="instui"])[data-layout="lightboxBlank"]:not([class*="instui-alert"])

```
:is(:scope, [class*="instui"]):is([data-layout="lightboxBlank"], [class*="instui-banner"]):not([class*="instui-alert"])

Two survey shapes, one opt-in token. The **PMF** guide has no `data-layout` and floats at 450px bottom-right; the **NPS** guide carries `data-layout="bannerNpsSurvey"` and spans the viewport bottom edge-to-edge. Fix: make `instui-banner*` the opt-in and widen every banner selector to `:is([data-layout="lightboxBlank"], [class*="instui-banner"]):not([class*="instui-alert"])`, then swap the banner's hard-coded `box-shadow: none` for a `--_banner-shadow` property so the opt-in branch keeps popover elevation.

Keying on the class rather than enumerating layout values is the load-bearing choice here — `bannerNpsSurvey` appears **nowhere** in the source today, which is exactly the kind of value Pendo can add without warning.

**Steps**

*Phase 1 — container.css (blocks everything else)*
1. Widen the `container: pantoken-pendo-guide / inline-size` rule on `._pendo-step-container-size`.
2. Widen the banner block root to the new selector. `-poll` already resolves the question-mark glyph.
3. Add `--_banner-shadow: none`; change `box-shadow: none` → `box-shadow: var(--_banner-shadow)`.
4. Move `margin: gap-cards-md 0` (and its compact twin) into a `&[data-layout="lightboxBlank"]` branch so the popover margins survive on both surveys (decision 5).
5. Add `&[class*="instui-banner"]:not([data-layout="lightboxBlank"])` setting `--_banner-shadow: var(--instui-elevation-above)`.
6. Scope the survey branch's `margin-bottom: space-md` — the one commented *"Cuts off box-shadow"* — with `:not([class*="instui-banner"])`, or the new elevation clips at the viewport edge.
7. Widen the container-query block; add defensive `:not([class*="instui-banner"])` to the survey/`tooltipBlank` padding rules only if the browser check shows them winning.
8. Doc comment: new `@modifier instui-banner`, new `@cssproperty --_banner-shadow`.

*Phase 2 — companion files (parallel)*

9. [chrome.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/chrome.css) — widen banner close-button positioning; verify both DOM orders (first child in PMF, **last** child in NPS).
10. [card.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/card.css) — widen both `._pendo-row` banner margin rules. The mock-flexbox rules key on `[data-pendo-justify-content]` and already apply.
11. [text.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/text.css) — widen banner typography; **critically**, add `:not([class*="instui-banner"])` to the survey block, whose blanket `& *:not(._pendo-close-guide) { font-size: … }` descendant rule out-specifies banner typography.

13. [inputs.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/inputs.css) — no NPS scale changes (decision 4); contrast-check radios and textarea on violet.

*Phase 3 — docs, tests, release*

14. [build.test.ts](renderers/pendo/tests/build.test.ts) — the existing test asserts `toContain("box-shadow: none;")`; update it and add `[class*="instui-banner"]` assertions across five files.

16. [docs/demos/pendo/index.html](docs/demos/pendo/index.html) — add **two** demos: the PMF card and the NPS bar.

The published build wraps everything in `@scope ([class*="instui"]._pendo-step-container)`. Inside

```css

still working with `scope: false` — an easy trap, since tests assert on the unscoped CSS strings.

`tests/build.test.ts` asserts with `toContain` on raw CSS text, so oxfmt line-wrapping can break a

stay on one line:

Do not enumerate Pendo `data-layout` values. Pendo ships ones the source never mentions (a PMF survey
has **no** `data-layout`; an NPS survey uses `bannerNpsSurvey`). Key variants off the theme class.
